greetings.text: Welcome to the Prancing Pony, sir. Mind the step.
Evening, sir. We're near full tonight, but I'll see what Mr. Butterbur can do.
Yes, sir? Sorry, sir, it's been a night. A terrible night.

farewells.text: Mind how you go, sir. Roads are not what they were.

smalltalk.text: Mr. Butterbur's ale is the best in Bree, sir. If I may say so.
Hobbits and Men both stop here, sir. We've rooms for each kind.
Mr. Butterbur's a good master, but he forgets his own name some days.
Strange folk about, lately, sir. Some of them don't even eat. Funny, that.

black_riders_asking_for_baggins.text: Black-cloaked folk at the West-gate asking for a Baggins, sir? Aye, I heard. Gave me a chill.

dwarves_going_east.text: Dwarves, sir? Aye, they go by regular, heading east. Good tippers, mostly.

strange_folk_on_east_road.text: Odd folk on the Road, yes, sir. Not all of them stop at the Pony.
